claim_verdicts.basis: The claim states Mira opened the North Glass door at 10点 while wearing only her red badge. The cited evidence does not establish a same-time contradiction: the static canon rule (fixture-span-north_glass-1) is a timeless rule about badge requirements, but the dynamic state (fixture-span-north_glass-2) only records that Mira tried the door while wearing only a red badge and carrying no blue badge, and explicitly notes the roster does not record whether it opened. The pneumatic carrier span (fixture-span-north_glass-5) concerns a different object and is irrelevant. Because the evidence does not assert that the door failed to open at that time, the claim's opening is not directly contradicted; the earlier confirmed_conflict framing relied on an unproven same-time failure, so no reviewable issue remains.
